name: adcopilot-microsoft-ads
description: Works with Microsoft Advertising: reads the Microsoft Advertising accounts you connect in AdCopilot (results, campaigns, search terms, conversion tracking, Microsoft's own recommendations, keyword ideas and auction insights, and checks for wasted spend, budget pacing and quality scores), and the Microsoft Clarity projects and Bing Webmaster Tools sites you connect where AdCopilot offers them to your workspace. It also checks the UET tag in Google Tag Manager, reports Bing traffic in Google Analytics (GA4), checks UTM and auto-tagging, plans a Google Ads import, drafts responsive search ads and does budget pacing math, in your AI client, through AdCopilot. It changes nothing in Microsoft Advertising, Clarity or Bing Webmaster Tools. Made by Atromx Intelligence, not by Microsoft.
